limitations: Scripted/replayed outputs do not predict new model answers or validate prompt improvements.
Archived metrics describe only that immutable recording, not the current workflow.
Mock Redis verifies application behavior; real Redis acceptance is separate.
Local TCP tests verify transport timing/cancellation, not provider latency.

retrieval.scope: frozen development queries; explicit corpus profile; not blind acceptance

configuration.isolation: fresh SQLite and Chroma under tmp; no default database or vector writes

retrieval_parameters.law_candidate_policy: top 3 BM25 preserved; one complementary regulation from anchor-text BM25 with reviewed-keyword boost; remaining slot diversified; maximum 5 positive query hits
